Description

Add a touch of fun and adventure to your school essentials with this eye-catching Stitch Pencil Pouch. Featuring a vibrant design and a cool Stitch character print, this pouch is perfect for kids who love their Favorite character.

Designed to keep stationery items neatly organized, it provides convenient storage for pencils, pens, erasers, sharpeners and other everyday school accessories. Its secure 2 zips closure helps keep belongings safe, while its compact and lightweight design makes it easy to carry inside a school bag.

▶ KEY FEATURES ◀

▶ H 5 INCHES ◀

▶ L 9 INCHES ◀

▶ ATTRACTIVE DESIGN ◀

▶ SPACIOUS COMARTMENTS FOR STATIONERY ESSENTIALS ◀

▶ LIGHTWEIGHT AND EASY TO CARRY ◀

▶ IDEAL FOR STORING PENS PENCILS ERASER AND SHARPENER ◀

▶ IDEAL FOR EVERYDAY USE ◀
